title: Field extension: open
description: What the value designates, opened from the field: a button at the end of its frame, there only while the field holds a value, leading to `url` — the value where it says `__value__`, the record's id where it says `__id__` — in a new tab, a modal or a panel (`in`).

url.description: The address opened, `__value__` standing for the field's value, `__id__` for the record's id.

in.description: Where it opens: a new tab, or the page loaded in a modal or a panel. Not `target`, which the design system gives every extension of a page's field (its control's id).

label.description: What the button says under the pointer and to whoever reads the page aloud; « Open » by default.
